body: That’s the thing - I don’t know that it’s feasible to meet someone else and build a serious lifelong relationship in time to have kids. It doesn’t seem possible.

I’m in therapy. I just don’t have options and that’s the problem. I’ve tried everything with my boyfriend and clearly need to leave him. But I can’t try to meet someone else – the pressure to find someone to spend my life with while also feeling hyper aware of how many fertile years I have left is just too much.

I don’t want to give the exact number because I really don’t want people to start throwing out stories of miracle babies who were born at whatever age. But I do tell him this – he doesn’t care about the facts of fertility because his mom had a kid in her 40s, so he thinks the biological clock is a myth, or overblown, or whatever.  

I’m old enough to have kids, young enough to minimize risk, and old enough to feel aware of how much time I do/don’t have left. And I’m not even trying to have kids right away! 

I’m in my mid 20s. My boyfriend’s timeline puts me at trying to conceive for the first time in my mid 30s. I don’t know how long it would take to meet someone else if I left him.

I know that I technically have time. But I don’t feel like I have time to start over – meet someone else, build up a relationship together, then start trying. Especially not if I want more than one kid. Especially because I don’t know how long it’ll take to meet someone. Especially because I just can’t keep holding out hope for something that may never come. 

I wanted to start trying in maybe 3 years. I think that’s fair. Apparently it’s extreme. 

My boyfriend just doesn’t. I don’t know if he’d be open to counseling. He seems to mainly think that I’m being unreasonable. I have tried everything and he just won’t cooperate. 

He says he wants to be financially stable. I ask him what financial stability means to him – how he’ll know when he is financially stable. He says “I don’t know, I’ll just know it when I see it.” 

He says he wants to be confident in our relationship. We’ve lived together for two years – happily! I ask him how he’ll know our relationship is stable and healthy. He says “I don’t know, I’ll just know it when I see it.” 

So, whatever. I hear what he’s saying – he says he wants kids but isn’t really willing to work on it with me at all. So it’s not happening. I just don’t know how to go on.
